title: PowerGrid: Important Systems
summary: Read the PowerGrid signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Battery banks buffer spikes, substations organize lines, breakers protect failures, meters explain the current state, and diagnostic tools identify why a consumer is offline.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch fuel, generation rate, stored energy, cable tier, breaker state, consumer demand, and whether one overloaded line is hiding behind several symptoms.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A PowerGrid system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: System Anchor
blocks.body: Use this reference to turn the system note into a concrete field check.
